lines.gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਰਾਖੈ ਮਮਤਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: ba(n)dhan mukat sa(n)tahu meree raakhai mamataa ||3||
lines.translation: He frees us from bondage, O Saints, and saves us from possessiveness. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਏ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਰਹਿਓ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhae kirapaal thaakur rahio aavan jaanaa ||
lines.translation: Becoming Merciful, my Lord and Master has ended my comings and goings in reincarnation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਾ ॥੪॥੨੭॥੯੭॥
lines.transliteration: gur mil naanak paarabraham pachhaanaa ||4||27||97||
lines.translation: Meeting with the Guru, Nanak has recognized the Supreme Lord God. ||4||27||97||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 ghar 1 ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl, First House:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਭਾਈਆ ਕਟਿਅੜਾ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t janaa mil bhaaeeaa katiaRaa jamakaal ||
lines.translation: Meeting with the humble beings, O Siblings of Destiny, the Messenger of Death is conquered.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਹੋਆ ਖਸਮੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachaa saahib man vuthaa hoaa khasam daiaal ||
lines.translation: The True Lord and Master has come to dwell within my mind; my Lord and Master has become Merciful.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਬਿਨਸਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਜੰਜਾਲੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: pooraa satigur bhetiaa binasiaa sabh ja(n)jaal ||1||
lines.translation: Meeting with the Perfect True Guru, all my worldly entanglements have ended. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਾ ਹਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere satiguraa hau tudh vitahu kurabaan ||
lines.translation: O my True Guru, I am a sacrifice to You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਤੁਸਿ ਦਿਤਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: tere darasan kau balihaaranai tus ditaa a(n)mrit naam ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. By the Pleasure of Your Will, You have blessed me with the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਤੂੰ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਭਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਸੇਈ ਪੁਰਖ ਸੁਜਾਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin too(n) seviaa bhaau kar seee purakh sujaan ||
lines.translation: Those who have served You with love are truly wise.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਾ ਪਿਛੈ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਜਿਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: tinaa pichhai chhuteeai jin a(n)dar naam nidhaan ||
lines.translation: Those who have the Treasure of the Naam within emancipate others as well as themselves.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਦਿਤਾ ਆਤਮ ਦਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: gur jevad daataa ko nahee jin ditaa aatam daan ||2||
lines.translation: There is no other Giver as great as the Guru, who has given the gift of the soul. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਏ ਸੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aae se paravaan hahi jin gur miliaa subhaai ||
lines.translation: Blessed and acclaimed is the coming of those who have met the Guru with loving faith.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ਦਰਗਹ ਬੈਸਣੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sache setee ratiaa daragah baisan jaai ||
lines.translation: Attuned to the True One, you shall obtain a place of honor in the Court of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਤੇ ਹਥਿ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: karate hath vadiaaeeaa poorab likhiaa paai ||3||
lines.translation: Greatness is in the Hands of the Creator; it is obtained by pre-ordained destiny. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਚੁ ਕਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੁ ਟੇਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach karataa sach karanahaar sach saahib sach tek ||
lines.translation: True is the Creator, True is the Doer. True is our Lord and Master, and True is His Support.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਸਚੋ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਿਬੇਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: sacho sach vakhaaneeai sacho budh bibek ||
lines.translation: So speak the Truest of the True. Through the True One, an intuitive and discerning mind is obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਵੈ ਏਕ ॥੪॥੨੮॥੯੮॥
lines.transliteration: sarab nira(n)tar rav rahiaa jap naanak jeevai ek ||4||28||98||
lines.translation: Nanak lives by chanting and meditating on the One, who is pervading within and contained amongst all. ||4||28||98||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰੁ ਪੂਜੀਐ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਲਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur paramesur poojeeai man tan laai piaar ||
lines.translation: Worship the Guru, the Transcendent Lord, with your mind and body attuned to love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਸਭਸੈ ਦੇਇ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur daataa jee kaa sabhasai dei adhaar ||
lines.translation: The True Guru is the Giver of the soul; He gives Support to all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ ਸਚਾ ਏਹੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur bachan kamaavane sachaa ehu veechaar ||
lines.translation: Act according to the Instructions of the True Guru; this is the true philosophy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਰਤਿਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bin saadhoo sa(n)gat ratiaa maaiaa mohu sabh chhaar ||1||
lines.translation: Without being attuned to the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, all attachment to Maya is just dust. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere saajan har har naam samaal ||
lines.translation: O my friend, reflect upon the Name of the Lord, Har, Har

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਘਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadhoo sa(n)gat man vasai pooran hovai ghaal ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: . In the Saadh Sangat, He dwells within the mind, and one's works are brought to perfect fruition. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur samarath apaar gur vadabhaagee darasan hoi ||
lines.translation: The Guru is All-powerful, the Guru is Infinite. By great good fortune, the Blessed Vision of His Darshan is obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਗੁਰ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur agochar niramalaa gur jevad avar na koi ||
lines.translation: The Guru is Imperceptible, Immaculate and Pure. There is no other as great as the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur karataa gur karanahaar guramukh sachee soi ||
lines.translation: The Guru is the Creator, the Guru is the Doer. The Gurmukh obtains true glory.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਹੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਕੀਤਾ ਲੋੜੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: gur te baahar kichh nahee gur keetaa loRe s hoi ||2||
lines.translation: Nothing is beyond the Guru; whatever He wishes comes to pass. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਜਾਤੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਨਸਾ ਪੂਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur teerath gur paarajaat gur manasaa pooranahaar ||
lines.translation: The Guru is the Sacred Shrine of Pilgrimage, the Guru is the Wish-fulfilling Elysian Tree.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਇ ਉਧਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur daataa har naam dei udharai sabh sa(n)saar ||
lines.translation: The Guru is the Fulfiller of the desires of the mind. The Guru is the Giver of the Name of the Lord, by which all the world is saved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਊਚਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur samarath gur nira(n)kaar gur oochaa agam apaar ||
lines.translation: The Guru is All-powerful, the Guru is Formless; the Guru is Lofty, Inaccessible and Infinite.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਅਗਮ ਹੈ ਕਿਆ ਕਥੇ ਕਥਨਹਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: gur kee mahimaa agam hai kiaa kathe kathanahaar ||3||
lines.translation: The Praise of the Guru is so sublime-what can any speaker say? ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੜੇ ਫਲ ਮਨਿ ਬਾਛੀਅਹਿ ਤਿਤੜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jitaRe phal man baachheeahi titaRe satigur paas ||
lines.translation: All the rewards which the mind desires are with the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਬ ਲਿਖੇ ਪਾਵਣੇ ਸਾਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: poorab likhe paavane saach naam de raas ||
lines.translation: One whose destiny is so pre-ordained, obtains the Wealth of the True Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣੀ ਆਇਆਂ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਨਹੀ ਬਿਨਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur saranee aaiaa(n) baahuR nahee binaas ||
lines.translation: Entering the Sanctuary of the True Guru, you shall never die again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵਿਸਰਉ ਏਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਾਸੁ ॥੪॥੨੯॥੯੯॥
lines.transliteration: har naanak kade na visarau ehu jeeu pi(n)d teraa saas ||4||29||99||
lines.translation: Nanak: may I never forget You, Lord. This soul, body and breath are Yours. ||4||29||99||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਹੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਭਾਈਹੋ ਛੂਟਨੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t janahu sun bhaaeeho chhootan saachai naai ||
lines.translation: O Saints, O Siblings of Destiny, listen: release comes only through the True Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਸਰੇਵਣੇ ਤੀਰਥ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur ke charan sarevane teerath har kaa naau ||
lines.translation: Worship the Feet of the Guru. Let the Name of the Lord be your sacred shrine of pilgrimage.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਗੈ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਮੰਨੀਅਹਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਨਿਥਾਵੇ ਥਾਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aagai daragahi ma(n)neeahi milai nithaave thaau ||1||
lines.translation: Hereafter, you shall be honored in the Court of the Lord; there, even the homeless find a home. ||1||
